title: Classification of Sedimentary Rocks
subject: Geography
description: A classification diagram for sedimentary rocks, categorizing them by their origin: Clastic (Detrital), Organic, and Chemical, with examples for each type.
mermaidCode:
graph TD
A[Sedimentary Rocks] --> B[Clastic (Detrital)]
A --> C[Organic]
A --> D[Chemical]
B -- From pre-existing rock fragments --> B1[Classified by grain size]
B1 --> B1a[e.g., Sandstone, Shale, Conglomerate]
C -- From plant or animal matter --> C1[e.g., Coal, Limestone]
D -- Precipitated from solution --> D1[e.g., Rock Salt, Gypsum, Chert]
